# Peacock

> > Peacock is NBCUniversal's streaming service offering live sports (NBA, Premier League, WWE, Olympics), original series, movies, NBC and Bravo shows, and Telemundo Spanish-language content.

Peacock features exclusive streaming access to NBCUniversal properties including NBC Sports, Bravo reality TV, Wolf Entertainment franchises (Law & Order, Chicago series), Telemundo telenovelas, and major sporting events. The platform offers same-day theatrical releases, Peacock Originals, and comprehensive live sports coverage across multiple subscription tiers.

## Key Topics

- Live sports streaming (NBA, Premier League, WWE, Olympics, MLB, NCAA)
- Peacock Originals and exclusive content
- NBC and Bravo programming
- Telemundo Spanish-language content and telenovelas
- Wolf Entertainment (Law & Order, Chicago franchises)
- Same-day theatrical movie releases
- Saturday Night Live and NBC comedy
- Regional sports networks (NBC Sports Boston)
- Subscription plans and pricing tiers
- Wicked: For Good Broadway adaptation
- Reality TV (The Traitors, Vanderpump Rules)
- Kids and family programming
- SuperMotocross and motorsports
- La Casa de los Famosos

## Live Sports Streaming

- [Watch NBA Basketball | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/nba): NBA Basketball streaming including Sunday Night Basketball on NBC/Peacock
- [Watch College Basketball LIVE | Stream NCAA Men's and Women's Basketball | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/college-basketball): NCAA basketball streaming: Big Ten, Big East, and Big 12 conferences
- [Watch 2026 Winter Olympics | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/olympics/golf): 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics streaming with multiview features
- [NBC Sports Boston on Peacock | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/sports/nbcsports-boston): NBC Sports Boston regional network with Celtics games and local sports

## Movies and New Releases

- [Watch Wicked: For Good (2025) | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-movies/wicked-for-good): Wicked: For Good Part 2 Broadway adaptation streaming exclusively
- [Watch Must-See Movies on Peacock Now | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-movies/get-out): Movie streaming catalog with new releases and Peacock originals
- [Watch Must-See Movies on Peacock Now | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-movies/downton-abbey-the-grand-finale): Movie catalog featuring blockbusters and same-day theatrical releases
- [Watch Drama Movies Online | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/drama-1): Drama movie collection with action, thriller, and family films
- [Watch Romantic Comedy Movies Online | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/movies/romantic-comedy-movies): Romantic comedy movie collection with classic and new rom-coms

## NBC and Original Series

- [Watch Wolf Entertainment Streaming on Peacock | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/wolf-entertainment): Wolf Entertainment collection with Law & Order and Chicago franchises
- [Watch SNL50: The Homecoming Concert | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/snl-50-the-homecoming-concert): SNL 50th anniversary concert special from Radio City Music Hall
- [Watch Brilliant Minds | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/brilliant-minds): NBC medical drama starring Zachary Quinto as neurologist Dr. Oliver Wolf
- [Best Reality TV Shows Streaming | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream/tv/reality): Reality TV collection with The Traitors, Vanderpump Rules, and Bravo shows

## Telemundo Spanish-Language Content

- [Watch Telemundo Streaming on Peacock | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/collections/telemundo): Telemundo collection featuring telenovelas and Spanish-language content
- [Watch Telemundo Streaming on Peacock | Peacock](https://www.peacocktv.com/stream-tv/todo-por-mi-hija): Telemundo telenovelas streaming page with Spanish-language programming
